defects.mechanism: A PR-40 session that finds a precise in-scope defect after a merge has two routes in the same body: REJECT to PR-20 with a new Proceed (C-REPLAN, graph, D23-F), or return to the existing PR owner (PR-30). The dedicated C-REPLAN heading and the graph make PR-20 the likelier choice. If the session follows the old sentence, it reopens PR-30 on a spent Proceed, which breaks D23-F's approval boundary and leaves the graph. That route was lawful before 09-23 but is not now.
defects.smallest_fix: In PR-40, replace the one sentence with a pointer to 'PRECISE IN-SCOPE DEFECT -> re-plan'. Add a registry forbidden pattern for the retired phrase and fire it with a regression.

That contradicts C-REPLAN (REJECT, re-plan) and the ITEM-31 leftover, so PR-40 has three instructions for one defect, and one of them crosses its execution boundary into landed code. In the planners and reviewers (PR-10, PR-20, IA-30, DOC-*, RS-*), 'implement' cannot be carried out and is likely read as 'decide it in the plan', which is low harm. None of these bodies had this text before 09-23.

defects.summary: The protected Flowmaster core pins stage prompts 'by exact identity and complete content' and keeps 'content hashes' in the ledger, which conflicts with D22's no-hash rule for GCFPE bodies.
defects.surface: change-flow SKILL.md:72, :122; session-relay-flowmaster SKILL.md:112 (core), plus relay :378 (see ITEM-06)
defects.origin_evidence: The core is byte-identical (4d8bb9bf) and was unchanged by the AF (core_sync true, ANALYZE-skill-evidence.md). The no-hash rule predates the AF (the 2026-09-21 prompt-corpus-policy directive, D22 'What was wrong').
defects.mechanism: A change-flow run pins each GCFPE prompt at first use and records its content hash in the ledger, which breaches D22 condition 3 and the prohibited list. On RESUME, if a body was since edited in place (as E6 did to all 55), the same ID resolves to different content, and D22 forbids keeping a pinned copy. The run therefore stops under 'prompt drift'. That stop is fail-safe. A FRESH run does not stop. No lifecycle run was in flight at E6 (E6-report step 0), and Alpha is run manually from pasted handoffs (inferred), so neither effect has been observed.
defects.smallest_fix: Add one GCFPE override sentence outside the core, in change-flow and the relay (A1-6 pattern): pin by stable ID, version and direct Notion URL, with no content hash. Add a CONTRACT_REQUIRED guard.

defects.smallest_fix: Rewrite the four lines and staging_rule to say that bodies arrive on --bodies-stdin and the candidate root holds the graph only. Re-declare SKILL_TREE_SHA256.
